enrichment method: added to titanium dioxide beads (5:1 [w/w] beads:protein)
fractionation method: Pierce High pH Reversed-Phase Peptide Fractionation Kit
fractionated and desalted by the use of a Pierce High pH Reversed-Phase Peptide Fractionation Kit
fragmentation method: with higher-energy collision dissociation (HCD) being the selected activation method
instrument: An Orbitrap Fusion Lumos was used for data acquisition
labeling: the corresponding TMTsixplex (0.8 mg) label (resuspended in anhydrous acetonitrile) was added
